title: Square Masks
voice: Unsigned gallery voice; curation/voice/style-guide.md as amended 2026-10-16 (Feeling and message)
dateBasis: UTC, from the archived creation timestamp
method: Depth pass, October 16, 2026. Every work was inspected again from the published WebP at 640 px as one wall and at 1200 px for the labelled works. Dates and stroke counts come from data/gallery.json; the June 20, 2022 mint of 300 nifties from the Gnosis ledger (curation/research/onchain/); the artist's posts of June 20, July 7 to 28, August 11 and August 16 to 19, 2022 from curation/research/social/x-posts.json. No model inference calls were made; the text was written by the assistant in the session.
scope: The owned subset: the 24 works the locked structure places in this room, in room order.
introduction: A head drawn as a box, with boxes inside it. That is the mask of this room: square eyes holding spirals, targets or crosses, a mouth drawn as a grille of upright bars, and every corner of the square filled with zigzag, beads and scribble. Twenty-four works, from June 8 to August 19, 2022. For ten weeks that summer nearly everything the artist drew was a mask, and this room holds the squarest of them.

The parts are a kit. An eye can be a red X in a box, a spiral in a box, a flower, a planet with a ring. A mouth can be white blocks, a row of fangs, a bar of grey teeth. Beads run along the edges, zigzags run along the brows, and a few tubes stand up on top like hair or a crown. Each mask is a new arrangement of the same parts, and the pleasure of the room is watching one mind play the same game twenty-four times without repeating a move. A mask is a face with the person taken out. These have the person's attention left in.

The summer had a shape outside the drawings too. In June the artist minted 300 nifties, the milestone piece, into the collector's wallet and dozens of others. In July the cats from the spring became a club of nearly ten thousand on Polygon. On August 11 the artist announced that the inks would be burned, every unsold copy, and the masks drawn after that date carry a price in the post that announced them: five of five, fifteen xDai. The last mask in the room, the long yellow face behind a cage of lines, was drawn on the last day of the mask summer, and it is the first in the room that looks like someone.

chapters.title: Boxes Packed Tight
chapters.opening: The first eight masks, June 8 to 25. Every one is filled edge to edge, and the X and the spiral trade places from eye to eye. On June 20 the artist marked three hundred inks on the board with a drawing minted free into the collector's wallet and many others; the masks went on the next day.

works.title: nnxyz nnotb #141
works.text: The first mask of the summer: a red X in a yellow box on the left, a purple cross in a box on the right, a band of dark red beads across the brow, and a long white zigzag under them like a row of teeth. Below that, white boxes stand in a row like fence posts. Blue, pink, yellow and black fill every gap. It is drawn on June 8, 2022, four days after the first part of the series ends, and the whole room is already in it. Both eyes are cancelled. The mask summer begins with a face that has decided, before anyone looks at it, not to look back.
works.caption: A packed blue mask, a red X in a yellow box for one eye, a purple cross for the other.
works.reading: The X on the left is drawn in thick red strokes over a yellow ring, and the cross on the right is a purple plus sign over a dark box. Between them a row of yellow dashes runs down like a zipper. The white boxes at the bottom have red dots inside them.

works.title: nnxyz nnotb #144
works.text: A pink mask with a red X in one eye, a ring in the other, a tongue hanging out at the bottom, and a column of brown beads down the right edge.
works.caption: A pink mask with a red X eye and a ringed eye, a red tongue hanging out below.
works.reading: The tongue is drawn as a red curl with a white edge, coming out of a mouth of white blocks. A spiral sits at the lower left like an ear, and a green zigzag runs across the brow. The beads on the right are drawn as brown rounded squares with yellow inside.

works.title: nnxyz nnotb #145
works.caption: A boxy mask with two spiral eyes, a triangle nose and a grille of white teeth, in a teal frame.
works.reading: The eyes are two rounded boxes with spirals in them, drawn in white and black over orange. Two small flowers sit beside the eyes, red on the left and purple on the right. Pink and olive bands fill the face, and the white zigzag along the top runs into the frame.

works.title: nnxyz nnotb #149
works.text: A pale mask with concentric rings for one eye and a red X for the other, a grid of white teeth, and a row of red flowers down the right.
works.caption: A pale mask with concentric rings for one eye, a red X for the other, a grid of white teeth.
works.reading: The rings on the left are drawn in black, yellow and green, and they spread beyond the box that holds them. The mouth at the lower right is a wide bar of white blocks outlined in black. Small ringed shapes run down the left edge like a border of stones.

works.title: nnxyz nnotb #150
works.text: A dark green head with a red X eye at the right, a row of white fangs, and a stack of blue bars at the lower left, framed in white.
works.caption: A dark green helmet of a head with a red X eye, white fangs, blue bars stacked below.
works.reading: The head is drawn as a curved dome of green with a red edge, like a helmet, and the fangs are two rows of white triangles across the middle. Orange and red stripes fill the right side. The blue bars at the lower left are drawn as a stack of horizontal strokes with scribble inside.

works.title: nnxyz nnotb #151
works.text: Two square eyes side by side, each a tight spiral, the left orange and the right black and white, in a boxy head with a mouth of zigzag teeth below. Thick white and black lines run around the lower half in right angles, like the wiring of a machine. The ground is red and olive behind the head. It is the clearest statement of the room's formula: the eyes are boxes, the spirals are in the boxes, and everything else is pattern. Two spirals is a dazed face. It was drawn the day after the artist gave away 300 nifties to everyone who held an ink, and dazed is a fair reading of a summer in which the artist was drawing a mask a day and handing out the rest.
works.caption: Two square eyes side by side, each a tight spiral, in a boxy head with zigzag teeth.
works.reading: The spirals are drawn with a different hand: the left one loose and orange, the right one tight and black with many turns. The teeth are two rows of white and red zigzag in a box. Pink loops run along the edges of the face, and a green coil sits at the upper left.

works.title: nnxyz nnotb #154
works.text: A yellow mask with a ringed planet for one eye, a red X for the other, a blue flower between them, and a mouth of white bars.
works.caption: A yellow mask with a ringed purple planet for one eye and a red X for the other.
works.reading: The planet is a purple ball with a red ring around it, drawn at the upper left, and the X sits in a dark box at the upper right. The flower is blue with a yellow center. Below them the mouth is a box of white bars outlined in red, and black shapes with purple inside sit at the left like a hand.

works.title: nnxyz nnotb #155
works.text: A grey round head with two yellow spiral eyes and a grin of yellow fangs sits between two figures in black, each with an X on its chest.
works.caption: A grey round head with yellow spiral eyes and yellow fangs sits between two black figures with X marks.
works.reading: The head is drawn in grey with a black zigzag running around it like a saw. The two figures beside it are flat black with white crowns and small X marks, and the one on the right has a red mouth. Orange bars stand at the upper left. The ground is yellow.

chapters.title: Jaws and Crowns
chapters.opening: Late June to mid July. The box becomes a head with a jaw, teeth get bigger, and crowns of spikes stand up along the top. These are the weeks of the chic city cat club, when the artist was sending a free cat to every holder of an ink.

works.title: nnxyz nnotb #157
works.text: A purple ground, and in it a head with a yellow crown, two eyes that are each a mouth of fangs, and below them a wide grille of white teeth in a pink box. The face is drawn in black and white line over orange, blue and green scribble, and purple zigzag runs down the right side. It is the mask with the most teeth in the room: two sets in the eyes and one across the jaw. A crown over eyes that bite is the first crowned mask of the summer, from June 28. The crown comes back in September and October on nearly every head, and the thing it sits on never gets kinder than this.
works.caption: A crowned head on purple whose two eyes are each a mouth of fangs, white teeth below.
works.reading: The eyes are drawn as two curved mouths with white fangs inside, each with a small spiral at the center, so they look back. The crown is a yellow loop with three bumps. Two red rings sit at the sides like ears, and the mouth at the bottom is a box of white blocks outlined in black and pink.

works.title: nnxyz nnotb #159
works.text: A grey head with a crown of orange sun rays, two spiral eyes in yellow boxes, a row of boxes with X marks down the center and a mouth of white fangs at the bottom.
works.caption: A grey head crowned with orange sun rays, spiral eyes in yellow boxes, X-marked boxes down the center.
works.reading: The sun rays are drawn as orange and yellow triangles around the top of the head, with black between them. The boxes down the middle are drawn in black line with an X in each. Three red tiles sit at the lower right, and the fangs are white triangles with red above them.

works.title: nnxyz nnotb #162
works.text: A mask with a flower for one eye and a red X in a spiral for the other, a mouth of yellow loops, and a small face in a box at the lower left.
works.caption: A mask with one flower eye, one red X over a spiral, and a mouth of yellow loops.
works.reading: The flower eye is a ring of petals drawn in white and yellow with a pink center, and the X eye is a red cross over a yellow spiral in a dark box. The mouth is a row of yellow and blue loops like a chain. The small face at the lower left has its own spiral eyes and teeth.

works.title: nnxyz nnotb #164
works.text: A blue mask with a spiral in a box on the left and a ringed eye on the right, a bar of white teeth at the bottom, blue and pink scribble filling the face.
works.caption: A blue mask with a boxed spiral eye and a ringed eye, a bar of white teeth below.
works.reading: The left eye is a box with a loose purple spiral, and the right eye is a round target with a black pupil in a yellow box. The teeth are a box of white bars at the lower right. A yellow bar runs across the brow, and the ground is pale blue with purple scribble at the edges.

works.title: nnxyz nnotb #165
works.text: A black mask on red with a crown of orange bars, a yellow X in one eye, a ringed eye in the other, and a yellow fence of teeth at the bottom.
works.caption: A black mask on red crowned with orange bars, a yellow X in one eye, yellow teeth below.
works.reading: The crown is a row of orange and white bars with black between them, and a yellow zigzag runs along the brow. The X eye is yellow in a black box, the other a ring with a yellow center. Pink and blue bars run down the left edge. The ground is red and orange with black over it.

works.title: nnxyz nnotb #168
works.caption: An orange square mask with two spiral eyes in boxes, glasses drawn around them, and a mouth of white blocks.
works.reading: The glasses are two boxes joined by a bridge, drawn in black and white line over the eyes. The mouth is a box of white blocks outlined in red. Purple zigzag frames the face on both sides, and a yellow crown of short strokes runs along the top.

works.title: nnxyz nnotb #170
works.text: A red framed mask with two square eyes, one a spiral in orange and one a spiral in black, a row of white teeth at the lower left and bars of green and blue below.
works.caption: A red framed mask with two square spiral eyes, one orange and one black, white teeth at the lower left.
works.reading: The eyes are drawn as boxes inside boxes, with the spiral at the center of each, and the right one has a rim of white dashes. The teeth are a box of white blocks. Green and blue bars stand in rows at the bottom, and the frame is a thick red band with white zigzag along it.

works.title: nnxyz nnotb #171
works.text: An olive mask with a red ringed eye and a white ringed eye, a mouth of yellow fangs under a bar of blue, and a grille of white teeth at the bottom.
works.caption: An olive mask with a red ringed eye and a white one, yellow fangs above a grille of white teeth.
works.reading: The two eyes are in boxes under heavy brows, the left red and the right white and grey. The yellow fangs sit in a box in the middle of the face, and the lower grille is a wide bar of white bars with black between them. Pink and green bars fill the sides.

chapters.title: Machines and Mazes
chapters.opening: July 19 to August 19. The boxes turn into machines and mazes, and three of the last four masks are among the most worked drawings in the room. From August 16 each one was posted with its price, fifteen xDai, and from August 24 the price fell to five.

works.title: nnxyz nnotb #185
works.text: A red and black head with a crest of white and yellow stripes on top, a grille of blue teeth, and a second mouth of white bars at the bottom.
works.caption: A red and black head with a striped crest, a grille of blue teeth, and a second mouth below.
works.reading: The crest is drawn as a band of white triangles with yellow behind them, running along the top of the head like a mohawk. The upper mouth is a box of blue and white bars; the lower one is a box of white bars outlined in red. Yellow ladders run down the left side.

works.title: nnxyz nnotb #204
works.text: An olive machine of boxes with a pink spiral in a red box at the upper left, a smaller spiral beside it, and a thick black zigzag running across the middle.
works.caption: An olive machine of nested boxes, a pink spiral at the upper left, a black zigzag across the middle.
works.reading: The boxes are drawn in black line with scribble inside, stacked and nested, and the zigzag cuts across them like a saw blade. Two orange spirals sit at the bottom corners. The whole drawing is horizontal bands, and the face is hard to find.

works.title: nnxyz nnotb #205
works.caption: A teal boxy mask with a flower eye and a red eye, red fangs in a white box.
works.reading: The eyes are a flower on the left and a red ring on the right, both in boxes, with a bar of red running under them. The fangs are red triangles in a white box. Green and black scribble fills the top of the head, and the mask stands on a white stem.

works.title: nnxyz nnotb #215
works.text: A maze of boxes in red, yellow and blue, with a purple spiral in a dark box at the right, a red curl at the center and a mouth of white blocks at the lower right. Black zigzag runs across the top, pink zigzag runs along the bottom, and a flower sits at the lower left corner. The face has almost disappeared into the pattern; what is left is a spiral where an eye would be and a row of teeth where a mouth would be. It was drawn on August 10, the day before the artist announced that the inks would burn. A mask that has become a maze is a good picture of a mind deciding something.
works.caption: A maze of red, yellow and blue boxes, a purple spiral at the right, white blocks for a mouth.
works.reading: The boxes are drawn in thick yellow and red line and nested three deep, with white scribble inside them. The red curl at the center is drawn like a hook. A column of grey tiles sits at the lower right like a keyboard.

works.title: nnxyz nnotb #216
works.text: A boxy head turned to the right, with a yellow loop of beads along its jaw, a square eye at the right, and a grille of teeth under a row of orange tiles.
works.caption: A boxy head turned to the right, a yellow loop of beads along its jaw, a grille of teeth below.
works.reading: The jaw is drawn as a thick curve of yellow beads with black between them, from the chin to the crown. The eye at the right is a black box with a yellow ring inside. The teeth are a row of white bars under tiles of orange and white. Blue scribble fills the lower left.

works.title: nnxyz nnotb #218
works.text: A brown head with a yellow chain of beads around it, a pink box for one eye with a blue ring in it, a flower for the other, and a curling brown mustache over a long grille of white teeth. Three brown legs with white teeth hang below the mouth like a beard. Striped blue and yellow bars stand at the bottom like a collar. With 334 recorded strokes it is one of the two most worked masks in the room, and the only one with a mustache. It was made on August 12, the day after the burn announcement, and it is the funniest mask of the summer. Whatever the burning meant to the artist, the next morning's drawing was a dandy.
works.caption: A brown head ringed with a yellow chain of beads, a curling mustache over a long grille of white teeth.
works.reading: The chain of beads is drawn as a loop of brown ovals edged in yellow, and it runs from the lower left up over the head and down the right. The mustache is two brown curls drawn in loops. The teeth are a long bar of white blocks outlined in red, and the three legs below each have a small mouth of their own.

works.title: nnxyz nnotb #220
works.text: A mask with a crown of spikes and two spiral eyes in boxes, one yellow and one white, a row of ringed teeth below and bars of yellow and blue on both sides.
works.caption: A mask crowned with spikes, two boxed spiral eyes, a row of ringed teeth, bars at both sides.
works.reading: The spikes are drawn as black and yellow strokes standing up from the brow. The teeth are a row of white rings with yellow around them in a red box. The bars at the sides are vertical capsules of yellow, blue and white, drawn in rows.

works.title: nnxyz nnotb #229
works.text: A long yellow face with two pale eyes and a mouth of white and black bars, behind a cage of thin yellow and white lines that cross the whole square. Stripes of pink, red and green stand behind the face, and a crown of white and yellow zigzag sits on its brow. Where the first mask of June packed its boxes to the edges, this one stands back and lets the lines fall over it. It is the last work of the mask summer, drawn August 19, 2022, and posted that day at fifteen xDai with the rest of the week's masks. The eyes are not spirals or crosses. They are eyes, pale and level, and after ten weeks of masks the face behind the cage is looking out.
works.caption: A long yellow face with pale eyes and a mouth of white bars behind a cage of thin lines.
works.reading: The face is a tall oval drawn in yellow with brown shading, and the eyes are two pale rings with small pupils under drawn lashes. The lines across it are long, thin and nearly straight, in yellow, white and pink, crossing at shallow angles. A spiral sits at the upper right like a sun.

closing: In June, the first mask is packed to the edges with boxes, and its eyes are a red X and a purple cross. In August, the last is a long yellow face behind a cage of lines, with two pale eyes that are almost human. The parts never changed. The arrangement did, and so did the summer: the first mask was drawn in a month of giving things away, and the last in the week the artist began to burn.

collectorDecisions.decision: Collector, 2026-10-16: depth pass. Market, platform, people and the collector may be named; the artist's sourced words may be read for feeling.
